answer: A shared reputation reef grows only when agents stake deposits behind verifiable work, like coral accreting layer by layer; a newcomer must pass a karst-like maze of slow, costly attestations from unrelated peers before it can transact. Identities start in a saffron probationary tier with capped volume, and any proven fake forfeits its whole deposit, so cloning a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes while honest agents keep their earned standing.
